scenes.say: Thick crema doesn't mean good coffee.
Crema hints at freshness. Not flavor.
Tiny outlets whip air into the coffee. The foam looks like crema. The flavor doesn't always match.
Fine honey foam looks promising. Coarse bubbles, less so.

scenes.title: The tip.
scenes.say: Taste first. Thick foam on a bitter cup means little.
Judge the cup, not the foam. Share this with a crema fan.
